name: BBa_25RT9PC8
title: The ECF16-cognate promoter P16
description: The cognate promoter P<sub>16 </sub>for the ECF16 sigma factor contains its specific binding site. Upon binding, the ECF16 sigma factor recruits the *E. coli* RNA polymerase to initiate transcription of the downstream gene. In our project, P<sub>16</sub> is placed upstream of the *GFP* reporter gene ([BBa\_K2717024](https://registry.igem.org/parts/bba-k2717024)), serving as the regulatory element that integrates upstream input signals and activates transcription only when the intact ECF16 sigma factor is present, thereby validating the AND-gate logic function.
